title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.2.86
description:
• 🛡️ Zero False Positives on OTP Page: Completely removed generic [role='dialog'] checking that previously misidentified the SMS resend options modal as an error, preventing premature browser closures.
• ⚡ Non-Aborting Resend Flow: Resend SMS cycles complete gracefully without killing tasks even if cooldowns or prompt dialogs appear.
• ⏱️ Extended OTP Polling Window: Polling timeout extended to 60s with automatic dialog dismissal, ensuring the browser stays open until real OTP is received and processed.
• 🎯 Strict Error Verification: Only explicit, confirmed Facebook error banners (e.g. rate limit, invalid mobile) trigger error states; no spurious errors displayed.
